tool_args.rationale: The narrow pilot cannot identify behavior away from s_grad near one or distinguish the recalled nonlinear mechanisms reliably. The open-branch probe is the targeted, lower-cost way to resolve that ambiguity before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows vary u_now but hold the other inputs nearly fixed, leaving competing mechanisms and gradient dependence poorly identified.
A finer trajectory is more costly and less directly targeted at the open-branch ambiguity.
It is not relevant to discriminating the candidate mechanisms.
